verdict.rationale: Cloudflare publishes a root llms.txt that links to per-product llms.txt indexes such as workers/llms.txt, plus a whole-corpus llms-full.txt. Every page is available as Markdown via an index.md mirror or an `Accept: text/markdown` header. A dedicated agent-setup hub, per-page "View as Markdown" links and a documentation MCP server round this out. A live probe confirmed llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with the expected index content.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Each product below links to its own llms.txt, which contains a full index of that product's documentation pages
Any page can also be retrieved as Markdown by sending an `Accept: text/markdown` header to the page's URL without the `index.md` suffix
Every docs page also carries "Copy as Markdown", "View as Markdown", and "Agent setup" links.
the `docs()` tool to search Cloudflare developer documentation
